Chosen One!

A free random finger chooser for game night.

Tap, hold, done. Chosen One makes it easy to pick who goes first, choose a volunteer, or break any tie, from 2 to 200 players.

Customize the look with colorful themes, use your own photos as a background, and keep things fair over time with built-in stats that track who's been winning (and losing) the most.

✉️ Contact

Privacy Policy

Chosen One is designed to respect your privacy.

  • Chosen One does not collect, sell, or share your personal data.
  • Game stats and settings are stored locally on your device and can be deleted at any time by removing the app.
  • In-app purchases and tips are processed securely by Apple via the App Store.
  • Chosen One does not show third-party ads.

I don't want your data. Just happier game nights.
